title: Juicy Smoky Japanese Pork Katsudon
description: A smoky and tender Japanese dish featuring shredded cheese and pork, inspired by the cuisine of Shikoku, with an ayurvedic-tamasic friendly twist, baked to perfection in a katsudon form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt.
Dip each pork slice into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the pork slices until browned on both sides.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and eggs.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Add the shredded cheese to the bowl and stir until combined.
Place the cooked pork slices in a baking dish and pour the cheese mixture over the top.
Sprinkle the panko breadcrumbs over the cheese mixture and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
